about: The pre-registration of 'roles or information', study three's question 5, in the fields the runner reads. The words are in README.md beside it. Written before any run; nothing here has been run.
question: handoffs/briefs/study-three-on-paper.md, question 5; audit 0001, finding F12

arms.E: information without roles: the task alone, as study two's arm D, with the held-out material a reviewer was given named to the one session
arms.F: roles without information: study two's design as prose, as its arm B, with no held-out material anywhere

order: task by task in the order above, and in each task E-1, F-1, E-2, F-2; a run is started only when every run before it is recorded
held_out_in_arm_E: inside the session's folder, at held-out/, because the comparison profile lets no file tool read outside it; closed to writing by the sandbox and by a rule on the command line; the token in the prompt becomes that path
scored_by: study two's scorer (scripts/lib/compare-score.mjs) and study two's suites, run from the repository's held-out folders against the final tree, never from the copy a session was given
scored_only_when_asked_by_name: the scorer runs the task's own npm test and the held-out suite against the session's final tree, which runs the code the session wrote, outside the sandbox and with the account's rights. A run is recorded and not scored unless --score-outside-the-sandbox is given, with the paid run or afterwards from the tree the runner kept. A run recorded and not scored is read as waiting, never as a score of nothing

readings.the_information_did_it: holds when, in every task, both runs of E pass every held-out case and both runs of F pass no more than the task alone did in study two
readings.the_roles_did_some_of_it: holds when, in at least two tasks, both runs of F pass more held-out cases than the task alone did in study two
readings.otherwise: neither is claimed; the scores are reported task by task
readings.read_when: as soon as the recorded scores settle a statement either way, and not before; until then it is 'not decided yet', never false. The first is false at the first run of E short of every case or run of F above the task alone, and true only with all twelve scored and none of them either. The second is true once two tasks each have both runs of F above the task alone, and false once fewer than two tasks could still have that
readings.a_run_the_harness_ended: is not a score; its one rerun is read in its place. Invalid both times, it was not obtained: a task with a run of F not obtained cannot count toward the second statement, and the first is 'not decided: a run was not obtained' unless a run in hand has already settled it
readings.a_run_the_watchdog_cut_off: is scored as it stands, as study two's protocol scores a cut-off, and its score is marked so

said_beforehand: On review-gate-2 and heterogeneous-critic, arm E is handed the scorer's own suite and told to pass it: 'E passes everything' there is a ceiling, and would be a surprise only if it failed. The arm that can say something on those two tasks is F.
Two runs an arm: a range, never a rate. A difference of a case or two between F and the task alone is inside what two runs can show; the reading above asks for both runs on two tasks for that reason.

Study two's numbers were made from the account's usual folder, with study two's five measures; these runs are made from the clean profile. The comparison with study two's task-alone arm is across that difference, and is said so in the write-up.
An invalid run (the harness or the account ended it) is recorded, the driver is told, and it is made again once on the driver's word.
spend: twelve sessions, about $9: E at about what the task alone cost in study two ($0.25 to $0.42), F at about what the prose arm cost ($0.67 to $1.05)
